faq.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a1: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard) via Fawaterak for local payments.
faq.q2: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a2: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. Your access will continue until the end of the current billing period.
faq.q3: What is the difference between CV building and parsing?
faq.a3: Building creates a new CV from scratch or template. Parsing extracts data from an existing CV to populate your profile.
faq.q4: Will I see ads on a paid plan?
faq.a4: No, as our policy, paid users enjoy an completely ad-free experience. All advertisements are automatically removed as soon as you subscribe to any premium plan.
